fields.entries.0: Overnight dock access maintained for deliveries.
fields.entries.1: Avery Chen, the authorized owner representative identified in the contract directory, requested six additional protective bollards at dock doors 3–5. Jordan and I checked issued plan S-22: it contains no bollards at those doors. Marked six positions for review; installation awaits PM release.

fields.item4: Owner requests six new bollards at dock doors 3–5 beyond the issued S-22 scope. Original tender schedule has no bollards at these doors. Avery confirmed authority, signed this direction, and acknowledged contractor receipt at 01:43. Existing dock protection elsewhere is unchanged.

fields.body: Jordan, confirming my signed direction during our site walk for six additional bollards at dock doors 3–5. They are outside original S-22 and the tender quantity schedule we reviewed together. Please submit the additional installation cost and notice for PM/owner review before release. My owner representative authority is unchanged. — Avery
